name: Pitchfork normal form divided at 1.3 times the threshold
question: Does the order survive a generation when the dip is long against the regrowth?
assumptions: benchmark written without a field: dphi/dt = a (L - L_c) phi - b phi^3 with a = b = L_c = 1
exponential growth at the rate 0.05; division at 1.3 L_c: ln G = (0.65 - ln 2)/0.05 < 0

provenance.source: normal form of a pitchfork with the size as its control (mission 7, law 2)
